title: Conformal Killing--Yano Ricci solitons: Structure, compatibility, and rigidity
summary: We introduce a geometric structure -- a conformal Killing--Yano Ricci soliton (CKY--RS) -- that couples conformal Ricci soliton (CRS) geometry to conformal Killing--Yano (CKY) 2--forms. The soliton field of the CRS geometry is given by the divergence of the CKY 2--form. We introduce a conserved CKY--Cotton current and derive a compatibility identity relating the Cotton tensor, the CRS obstruction tensor, and the CKY 2--form.
